text: Touring Toledo, Lisa Reiner sees a fresco of [the Devil carrying off the dead|threat|the devil and dark gods] and soon meets Leandro, a man who shares its face. Lost at nightfall, she shelters at a villa where Leandro serves a blind countess and her son Maximilian, who calls Lisa by the name of his lover Elena. Bodies gather around the house, and Lisa wanders [a bedroom full of dummies|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] where [the past love affair still festers|wrong|love betrayed] behind locked doors.
